{{Quote|She's a Lamborari GS7. Only 800 of them were manufactured...|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika">[[Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika 2|''Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika'' 2]]</ref>}}
The '''GS7''' was a class of luxury [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was manufactured by [[Lamborari]] around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Supposedly, only eight hundred of these ships were ever manufactured, and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] owned one.
